response.answer: Recent trends in Health & Medical Sciences focus on multi-omics modeling of gut methanotrophy and microbial-host interactions, revealing complex microbiome dynamics and their health impacts. Genome-scale metabolic models are increasingly used to understand microbial interactions. Studies highlight the gut microbiome's role in host fitness and disease pathogenesis.
